mathgap.title: Directed More-Than Interpretation
mathgap.principle: Translate comparative statements of the form 'A has N more (or fewer) items than B' into the equation A = B + N (or A = B - N), preserving sign.
mathgap.when_to_apply: Whenever a statement directly compares two people's counts with a fixed offset (e.g., 'A has N more/fewer items than B').
mathgap.example: Misinterpreting 'A has 5 more items than B' as setting A = 5 instead of A = B + 5.

mathgap.title: Immediate Direct Assignment Update
mathgap.principle: A direct count statement (e.g., 'A has N items') sets the current value of A to N at that point, overriding any previous value.
mathgap.when_to_apply: When encountering a sentence that explicitly states a person's count.
mathgap.example: Treating a later direct assignment as irrelevant because a previous value was already set.

mathgap.title: Temporal Consistency of Transfers and Relational Statements
mathgap.principle: Process statements in the order given; apply each transfer immediately, updating the giver's and receiver's counts before any later statements that refer to them.
mathgap.when_to_apply: Whenever a transfer ('X gives N to Y') appears, adjust counts right away.
mathgap.example: Delaying a transfer until after processing later relational statements, causing incorrect values.

mathgap.title: Full Difference Equality Interpretation
mathgap.principle: For sentences equating two differences, translate them into the form (A - B) = (C - D), preserving the order of names on each side.
mathgap.when_to_apply: When encountering a statement that says 'the number of X has more than Y is equal to the difference between the number of A and B'.
mathgap.example: Treating 'the number of X has more than Y' as X = Y + N instead of X - Y = A - B.

mathgap.title: Quantity Modification (Multiplication and Subtraction)
mathgap.principle: When a statement modifies a count by multiplication, division, or subtraction (e.g., 'X increases by N times' or 'X decreases by N'), apply the operation to the current value of X.
mathgap.when_to_apply: When encountering phrases like 'increases by N times', 'decreases by N', 'adds N', etc.
mathgap.example: Interpreting 'X increases by 2 times' as X = X + 2 instead of X = X * 2.

mathgap.title: Redistribute Equally Among Group
mathgap.principle: If a group of people redistributes their items so that each ends up with the same amount, compute the total items among them and divide by the group size.
mathgap.when_to_apply: When a statement says that a group equalizes their counts.
mathgap.example: Assuming each person keeps their original count instead of equalizing.

mathgap.title: Comprehensive Constraint Extraction
mathgap.principle: Gather every constraint implied by each statement, even those that do not directly involve the queried person, to build a complete system of equations.
mathgap.when_to_apply: For every statement, extract all relationships, not just those mentioning the target.
mathgap.example: Ignoring a difference equality that doesn't involve the target, missing a necessary equation.

mathgap.title: Signed More-Than Difference Equality Interpretation
mathgap.principle: Within a difference equality, treat a phrase like 'the number of X has more than Y' as the signed difference X - Y (which may be negative if X < Y).
mathgap.when_to_apply: When parsing the left side of a difference equality that uses 'has more than' or 'has fewer than'.
mathgap.example: Interpreting 'X has more than Y' as |X - Y| instead of X - Y.

mathgap.title: Signed Difference Phrase Interpretation
mathgap.principle: When a phrase contains 'the difference between the number of X and Y', interpret it as the signed subtraction X - Y, preserving order.
mathgap.when_to_apply: When parsing the right side of a difference equality that uses 'difference between'.
mathgap.example: Treating 'difference between X and Y' as absolute difference |X - Y|.

mathgap.title: Difference Equality Numeric Evaluation
mathgap.principle: When a difference equality (X - Y = A - B) involves variables whose values are already known, compute the numeric result and substitute it.
mathgap.when_to_apply: After solving for some variables, evaluate any remaining difference equalities that become numeric.
mathgap.example: Leaving an equation (X - Y = 5) unevaluated when X and Y are known.

mathgap.description: Treating ‘difference between the number of X and Y’ as absolute value instead of signed subtraction.
mathgap.why_it_happens: The phrase 'difference between' is ambiguous; models may default to the absolute difference.
mathgap.how_to_avoid: Always interpret 'difference between X and Y' as the signed subtraction X - Y, preserving the order of names.

mathgap.description: Delaying the effect of transfer statements until after all other statements.
mathgap.why_it_happens: Model may treat transfers as a separate batch rather than sequential updates.
mathgap.how_to_avoid: Process each transfer immediately when it appears, updating both parties before any later statements.

mathgap.description: Considering a direct count as a fixed initial value that cannot be changed by later transfers.
mathgap.why_it_happens: Model may treat direct assignments as final values, ignoring subsequent modifications.
mathgap.how_to_avoid: Treat direct counts as setting the current value, which can be later altered by transfers or other operations.

mathgap.description: Misinterpreting a difference equality as a direct assignment to a single variable, ignoring the second term (including assuming positivity).
mathgap.why_it_happens: Simplification bias leads to focusing on one side of the equation and dropping the other term.
mathgap.how_to_avoid: Maintain the full equation (A - B = C - D) and solve for unknowns using both sides.

mathgap.description: Misinterpreting 'increases by N times' as addition or division instead of multiplication.
mathgap.why_it_happens: Confusing phrasing of multiplicative increase with additive or divisive operations.
mathgap.how_to_avoid: Interpret 'increases by N times' as multiplication: X = X * N.
